🌱

Your learning playground.

Pick a quest, read the pattern guide, and play its animation. Write a real Java solution, then Run the sample cases or Submit solution against every built-in case.

Earn 10 points for Easy, 25 for Medium and 50 for Hard on your first accepted solve. Review it after 2, 7 and 21 days. Challenge mode adds an optional timer when you feel ready.

The first Java run downloads a browser JDK from CheerpJ. It needs internet and may take a minute. Java code executes in the browser. C, C++ and Python execute online through Wandbox after Google sign-in. Results appear in this editor. Problems with private hidden tests require the private judge before acceptance. Timings include the selected compiler’s execution path.

Sign in with Google to access the problem library and sync your progress across devices. Your drafts and notes are private to your account. Use Backup for a download. Test results and XP are practice records, not competition rankings.
